summary_md: **Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2115443044866797930))** highlights a merged **llama.cpp** CUDA PR (#31188) that fuses MoE gate/up matmuls and the GLU into a single MMQ launch, giving about **+17% prefill throughput on DGX Spark (GB10)** and ~+6% on an RTX 5090 — no model or VRAM changes needed.

referenced_urls.title: CUDA: fuse MoE gate/up matmuls and GLU in MMQ by anujj · Pull Request #31188 · ggml-org/llama.cpp

relevance: A free kernel-level speed-up for MoE models on exactly Richard's hardware via the most common local runtime.
